scheme_name: Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agricultural Development Programme
description: A comprehensive multi-departmental program targeting overall agricultural development at the Gram Panchayat level by converting fallow lands into cultivable land and creating water assets.
benefits: Free distribution of coconut saplings, horticulture kits, micro-irrigation grants, and community borewell installations.
eligibility: Farmers residing in selected focus Gram Panchayats across Tamil Nadu
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / Village Agricultural Extension Centers

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Pumpset Scheme
description: Provides standalone off-grid solar-powered irrigation pumpsets to replace diesel engines, ensuring uninterrupted daytime crop irrigation.
benefits: 70% state subsidy (30% Central + 40% State) on 5 HP, 7.5 HP, and 10 HP solar pumpsets; farmer pays remaining 30%.
eligibility: Farmers in Tamil Nadu with an active well/borewell water source
Must not have an existing TANGEDCO grid agricultural electricity connection
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / AED (Agricultural Engineering Dept)

description: Promotes cultivation and processing of major and minor millets (Ragi, Cholam, Kambu, Samai) across rainfed districts to tackle climate resilience and dietary health.
benefits: 100% subsidy on millet seed mini-kits, 50% subsidy on crop production inputs, and grants for establishing millet processing machinery.
eligibility: Farmers and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) cultivating millets in notified Tamil Nadu districts
application_mode: Uzhavan Mobile App / Local Block Agri Office

description: Aimed at transforming chemical-intensive agricultural lands into chemical-free certified organic farms through training, bio-input production hubs, and certification support.
benefits: Financial aid of ₹10,000 per hectare for organic inputs, vermicompost unit setup, and free PGS/TNOCCA organic certification.
eligibility: Individual farmers or farmer clusters dedicated to converting land to organic practices
application_mode: Online via TNOCCA Portal / Uzhavan App

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Mannuyir Kaathu Mannuyir Kaapom Scheme
description: Focuses on rebuilding soil organic carbon and soil health by distributing green manure seeds, bio-fertilizers, and liquid bio-inoculants statewide.
benefits: 50% subsidy on green manure seeds (Daincha, Sunnhemp) and free distribution of bio-fertilizers/Trichoderma viride kits.
eligibility: All resident farmers holding agricultural land in Tamil Nadu

description: Subsidizes high-cost agricultural machinery including power weeders, paddy transplanters, tractors, sugarcane harvesters, and brush cutters.
benefits: 40% subsidy for general category farmers and 50% subsidy for SC/ST, small, marginal, and women farmers.
eligibility: Resident farmers registered on the Uzhavan portal in Tamil Nadu
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / AED Portal

description: A targeted seasonal package for Delta region farmers to maximize Kuruvai paddy production using certified seeds, fertilizers, and mechanized transplanting.
benefits: Full subsidy (100%) on certified paddy seeds, micronutrient mixtures, and chemical fertilizers for eligible acres.
eligibility: Paddy farmers in Cauvery Delta districts (Thanjavur, Tiruvarur, Nagapattinam, Mayiladuthurai, etc.)
application_mode: Uzhavan Mobile App / Local Agri Extension Officers

scheme_name: Periyar Ninaivu Samathuvapuram Horticulture Kit Distribution
description: Promotes household nutritional security by distributing rooftop vegetable gardening kits, fruit tree saplings, and high-yield seed packets to rural and semi-urban households.
benefits: 75% subsidized rooftop garden kits, fruit plants (Guava, Amla, Lemon), and vegetable seed mini-kits.
eligibility: Resident households, women, and small farmers across Tamil Nadu
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / Horticulture Department Outlets

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Micro Irrigation Scheme (TANIDA / PMKSY)
description: Provides financial aid for installing drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to conserve water in sugarcane, banana, coconut, and vegetable crop fields.
benefits: 100% full subsidy for Small and Marginal farmers; 75% subsidy for other landholding farmers.
eligibility: Landholding farmers in Tamil Nadu with functional irrigation wells or canal access
application_mode: Uzhavan App / Micro Irrigation Information System (MIIS) Portal

scheme_name: State Protected Agricultural Zone (SPAZ) Sustainable Support
description: Provides special financial and input incentives to farmers in the Cauvery Delta region to preserve agricultural land from industrial encroachment and support pulse/oilseed cultivation.
benefits: Subsidized pulse seed kits, free soil health testing, and prioritized zero-interest seasonal crop loans.
eligibility: Farmers holding agricultural land within the designated Protected Agricultural Zone districts
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / Local Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACCS)
